messages.content: You are testing the agent. Do exactly: (1) bash: run PowerShell Get-ChildItem in the workspace root and capture names only. (2) file_read README.md from workspace if it exists, else file_read any one .md file you find. (3) Reply in 2-3 English sentences: file count theme, and one line from the file you read. Use tools; do not invent file contents.
